# `ceangal.view`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_api_docs.py from ceangal/src/view.almd; do not edit. -->

_Views and modifiers: text, col, row, styles, events, accessibility._

ceangal View — the declarative UI node.

Create with text / col / row / spacer / custom, refine with modifiers
(every modifier is View -> View), compose with ordinary functions:

  v.col([v.text("Hello") |> v.font(20.0), button("Run", on_run)])
    |> v.padding(16.0) |> v.gap(8.0) |> v.bg(theme.surface)

Event handlers are closures stored on the node.

```almide
import ceangal.view
```

```almide
type Color = snaidhm.Color
```

### `Style`

```almide
type Style = {
  width: Float, height: Float, width_pct: Float, height_pct: Float,
  min_width: Float, min_height: Float, max_width: Float, max_height: Float,
  pt: Float, pr: Float, pb: Float, pl: Float,
  mt: Float, mr: Float, mb: Float, ml: Float,
  grow: Float, shrink: Float, gap: Float,
  justify: Int, align: Int, align_self: Int,
  absolute: Bool,
  pos_top: Float, pos_right: Float, pos_bottom: Float, pos_left: Float,
  clip: Bool,
  wrap: Bool,
  bg: Color, fg: Color,
  radius: Float, opacity: Float,
  border_width: Float, border_color: Color,
  shadow_blur: Float, shadow_dy: Float, shadow_color: Color,
  font_size: Float, mono: Bool, bold: Bool,
  cursor: Int,
}
```

### `Pointer`

```almide
type Pointer = { phase: Int, x: Float, y: Float, w: Float, h: Float, buttons: Int, mods: Int, id: Int }
```

A pointer event as handlers see it: position relative to the node.

### `Painter`

```almide
type Painter = (Float, Float, Float, Float) -> Unit
```

A custom node paints itself into its laid-out rect (logical px) and may
claim pointer events. `key` identifies it across frames.

### `View`

```almide
type View = {
  kind: Int,
  children: List[View],
  content: String,
  style: Style,
  key: String,
  on_click: () -> Unit,
  clickable: Bool,
  on_pointer: (Pointer) -> Bool,
  pointer: Bool,
  on_wheel: (Float, Float, Float, Float) -> Bool,   // (x, y, dx, dy) in node px
  wheel: Bool,
  // A vertical scroll view (see scroll_y): children move up by the offset
  // ceangal keeps for `key`; wheel and touch drag scroll it.
  scroller: Bool,
  // Keyboard focus: a focusable node (it needs a key) receives key and text
  // events while focused; `text_input` asks the host for IME / soft keyboard.
  focusable: Bool,
  text_input: Bool,
  // Taps inside leave focus where it is (a key bar above the soft keyboard).
  keeps_focus: Bool,
  on_key: (Int, Int, Int) -> Bool,           // (phase, key, mods)
  on_text: (Int, String, Int) -> Bool,       // (kind, text, preedit cursor)
  on_focus: (Bool) -> Unit,
  paint: Painter,
  label: String,
  role: Int,
  // Text an assistive technology reads as the node's value (text fields,
  // editors). Called once per committed frame, so keep it cheap.
  value: () -> String,
  // State an assistive technology announces: 4 selected, 8 checked,
  // 16 disabled (docs/abi.md §4.4).
  states: Int,
}
```

### `Justify`

```almide
type Justify = | Start | End | Center | Between | Around | Evenly
```

Main-axis distribution and cross-axis alignment. (Variants rather than Int
constants: a dependency's top-level `let` cannot be referenced from an app
on the wasm leg yet — almide/almide#3286.)

```almide
type Align = | Top | Bottom | Middle | Stretch
pub fn justify(v: View, j: Justify) -> View
pub fn align(v: View, a: Align) -> View
pub fn align_self(v: View, a: Align) -> View
pub fn center(v: View) -> View
```

### `scroll_y`

```almide
pub fn scroll_y(v: View, key: String) -> View
```

Make a view scroll its content vertically when it is taller than the view
(give it a height or max height). `key` keeps the offset across frames.

### `checked`

```almide

```

Announced as checked (a checkbox, switch or radio button: give it that role).

### `selected`

```almide
pub fn selected(v: View, on: Bool) -> View
```

Announced as the selected one (a tab, a list item, a segment).

### `disabled`

```almide
pub fn disabled(v: View, on: Bool) -> View
```

Announced as unavailable. It only marks the view: leave out its handlers
too (the ceangal.widgets controls do).
